summary: All security gates pass. No eval/Function, no user input in generators, no path traversal in registry, determinism preserved, no injection in formatPolynomial, no as any/@ts-ignore. Phase 1+2 invariants verified.

no_eval_or_function.detail: Zero uses of eval() or new Function() in any modified file across the Phase 3 diff.

no_user_input_in_generators.detail: Generators accept only { seed: number } or GeneratorInput (seed, nodeId, difficulty). No request/query/body/params data reaches generator code.

no_path_traversal_in_registry.detail: registry.ts uses static ES module imports exclusively. No dynamic import(), require(), or path construction from input data. Test files use hardcoded resolve(__dirname, '../filename.ts') for architectural lint complements — zero risk from user-controlled paths.

determinism_preserved.detail: All same-seed determinism tests pass: rational-analyzer 2/2, exp-log-solver 2/2. The shared seededRandom in utils/prng.ts uses the identical arithmetic as the 6 original copies ((s * 1103515245 + 12345) & 0x7fffffff, s / 0x7fffffff). seed-523 golden in generator-registry.test.ts unchanged.

no_injection_in_formatPolynomial.detail: formatPolynomial uses only String(), Math.abs(), string concatenation, and a static SUPERSCRIPTS lookup table. No eval, no innerHTML, no dangerouslySetInnerHTML, no dynamic code execution.

no_as_any_or_ts_ignore.detail: Zero new as any or @ts-ignore annotations in the Phase 3 diff.

phase1_invariant_fr3_guard.detail: FR-3 balanced-brace guard: exit 0, 664 typed tags across 2246 scanned files, 0 violations.

phase2_invariant_student_visualization.detail: studentVisualization.test.ts: 4/4 tests pass (FR-5 test deleted per spec, no regressions).

architectural_gates.rational_no_hardcoded_isZero: isZero: false replaced with computed expression
architectural_gates.prng_docstring_corrected: FR-11: docstring in prng.ts explicitly documents JS double-overflow caveat
